title: This MP corrects the dependencies of krb5-kdc so that it is installable after the 64-bit time_t transition.
description: This MP corrects the dependencies of krb5-kdc so that it is installable after the 64-bit time_t transition.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index f569a41..1fb54a8 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+krb5 (1.20.1-5.1ubuntu1) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/control: Change the krb5-kdc dependencies to use t64-suffixed libraries.
+
+ -- Zixing Liu <zixing.liu@canonical.com>  Thu, 21 Mar 2024 14:02:29 -0600
+
 krb5 (1.20.1-5.1build3) noble; urgency=medium
 
   * No-change rebuild against libcom-err2
diff --git a/debian/control b/debian/control
index c9633b9..b636edd 100644
--- a/debian/control
+++ b/debian/control
@@ -54,7 +54,7 @@ Depends: krb5-config,
          libkadm5srv-mit12,
          libkdb5-10t64 (>= 1.13.1+dfsg-1),
          libkrb5-3 (= ${binary:Version}),
-         libverto-libev1 | libverto-libevent1,
+         libverto-libev1t64 | libverto-libevent1t64,
          lsb-base (>= 3.0-6),
          ${misc:Depends},
          ${shlibs:Depends}
